d16.task: D16: calibrate the events of equipment, food, menu and suppliers
d16.convention: effects = what the event does when the player makes no move. playerMoves[].cost = what the move costs (oneTime and monthly dollars, lostSales as a share of the month, other = non-money price). playerMoves[].result = the effects that replace the default when the move is made; an empty result means the event does not happen. engine: true marks an effect on a target the engine reads today (shared/src/types.ts EffectTarget); engineEffects repeats them in the engine shape { target, mult }.
conversions: Stock written off: cost of goods x (1 + dollars / $13260) for one month.
Days closed or items off the menu: demand x (1 - days / 30 x share of sales affected).
Cups and lids: the engine keeps them in the supplies line ($1020 a month), so a change of p% is carried as cost of goods x (1 + p x 1020 / 13260).

Ingredient price change of p%: cost of goods x (1 + p x share), shares from D04 extra.cogsShares (coffee and retail beans 39.7%, bakery 29.6%, dairy 9.9%, oat milk 5.2%, syrups, tea and chocolate 4.3%, matcha 2%).
Capacity in D03, D04 and D02: mapped to staffAvailability, the only capacity target the engine has.
Price moves: demand x (1 - 1.3 x price change), the pack price elasticity.

mechanics.title: Events that cost a sum of money once
mechanics.engineMath: Add EffectTarget "cash" with an amount instead of a multiplier, charged on the day the event starts (repairs, payoffs, cleanup, glass). D03 asked for the same as oneTimeCost.

mechanics.title: An event that leaves a violation open
mechanics.playerDecision: take the lawful move or leave the condition
mechanics.engineMath: An effect { field: "violation", id } opens the same trail a shortcut opens: the next inspection (or a complaint) finds it and the pack fine applies. Without a move the trail stays open.

mechanics.title: Each event lists its own answers with prices
mechanics.playerDecision: choose one move when the event is announced or found
mechanics.engineMath: playerMoves[] with cost { oneTime, monthly, lostSales } and result (replacement effects). The engine charges the cost and swaps the effects; an empty result cancels the event. This lets the host and the advisor show the price of every answer.

mechanics.title: Events that change quality or reputation
mechanics.engineMath: Add EffectTarget "quality" and "reputation" as additive changes for the event duration (dull burrs, stale beans, missing loyalty points).

mechanics.title: Average ticket moves with the season
mechanics.engineMath: D04 iced_season lowers revenue per order (x0.974). Add EffectTarget "ticket" multiplying the order price without changing orders.

mechanics.title: An event that raises one cost line
mechanics.engineMath: EffectTarget "monthlyCost:<id>" multiplies or adds to a named line (waste carter, supplies). Today supplies changes are carried as a cost-of-goods equivalent.

mechanics.title: Effects that apply only to some shops
mechanics.playerDecision: the condition is a lever or a place
mechanics.engineMath: Effects carry appliesIf: a lever option (seasonal_menu = seasonal), a place attribute (south of 60th Street, Croton-blend water) or a format (bubble tea). The engine already filters by niche and place tier; it needs lever and place-attribute filters.

mechanics.title: A decision now, a bill later
mechanics.playerDecision: skip the water treatment or the inspection
mechanics.engineMath: Effects with afterMonths fire later (a warranty voided at installation shows up as an uncovered repair 4-12 months on). This is how a decision event can stay deterministic without chance.
